## Result

The best current working theory is:

```text
AQABBA  = possible Jupiter-/Venus facies/register class in the circle [C0]
okaldy  = Bade-/Behandlungseintrag                              [C0]
otaldy  = Wurzel-/Drogenartikel                                 [C0]
```

These are complete-form, context-bound working meanings, not translations of
`ok`, `ot`, `al` or `dy`. The result is a hybrid: one local source-family may
carry status-like graphical material, while the two full strings behave as
different learned content entries.
